method: Wikimedia Commons API (action=query, prop=imageinfo with extmetadata) with User-Agent 'WasteLandEdition/1.0 (annotated poem site)'. Only files whose extmetadata License/LicenseShortName is public domain (pd), CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA were accepted. Files were downloaded as Commons thumbnails; Wikimedia now restricts thumbnails to standard widths (500, 960, 1280, 1920...), so 1400 px was not available: 1280 was requested and files over ~350 KB fell back to 960 px or to the reduced-quality 'qlow-' variant, and small originals were taken as-is. Second pass (the last 13 records, 20 Sep 2026): upload.wikimedia.org began answering this client with HTTP 429 (Retry-After 600) after the earlier fetch job's retries, so downloads were made with curl (a fresh connection per request, the same 3 s pacing) and, whenever the upload host still returned 429, the identical thumbnail was requested through commons.wikimedia.org/w/thumb.php; the licence check still used the Commons extmetadata gathered earlier. The first-edition title page and cover are page renderings (page 9 and page 1) of the Commons DjVu of the Boni & Liveright printing.
